'''Ghost rattles''' were used by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]], such as [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], to ward off evil spirits. It was constructed from a loop of leather with shells and pieces of stone threaded through which facilitated a noise when moved. The shaman shook the rattle while chanting specific incantations.
